This is one dissent recorded in a manifesto about sustaining human knowledge in the age of AI. Which fault line does it fall on?

Options:
- consent_or_payment: consent and payment mechanism: opt-in / levies / dues on existing text vs open training, pay at output, contracts for new work (Salib, Bratton, O'Reilly against the majority)
- model_in_loop: whether a model belongs in the checking loop or the room at all (Becker, Turkle)
- other: anything else

Text:

Human-only oversight at scale is theatre; the real question is auditors' independence, not whether they are machines.

parsed.why: The dissent is about whether models belong in the checking loop. It argues that "Human-only oversight at scale is theatre" and that what matters is "auditors' independence, not whether they are machines." That places it on the model-in-the-loop fault line (Becker, Turkle), taking the pro-machine side. It says nothing about consent or payment.
